name: Job Hunt Plugin
description: A job search's companies, postings, applications, interviews and contacts, in tables of the plugin's own: each listed and searched word by word, applications moved on, interviews scheduled and written up, the pipeline at a glance with the interviews still waiting for notes, and a job contact linked to the professional CRM contact the agent added first. The learning path's Extension 6, ported from its standalone MCP server (SMD-2311).
